title: A normalized affine singleton comparison has zero kernel.
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module, $u:U\to X$ and $w:W\to X$ affine objects of the small etale site, $g:W\to U$ an $X$-morphism, and $n\in\mathbf N$. Let $f$ be an additive homomorphism from degree $n$ of the lifted Amitsur complex to degree $n$ of the singleton tensor-section Cech complex, satisfying the pure-tensor normalization [new-etale-affine-singleton-tensor-degree-comparison-hom-normalization]. Then for every source element $x$, $f(x)=0$ implies $x=0$.

source.place: Tag 03P2, affine tensor calculation, using Tags 01I4, 01JQ, 01I9, 01IA

proof.text: Put A=Gamma(U,O), B=Gamma(W,O), M=Gamma(U,u*F), and P equal to the product of n+1 copies of W over U. Iterate the binary affine fibre-product spectrum formula. The projection equations identify the indexed tensor inclusions with pullbacks along P to W. Thus P is affine and its ring of sections is the indexed tensor power of B over A.

The pullback u*F is quasi-coherent. Compare tensor pullback with ordinary pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints to the same pushforward, and transport this property along that isomorphism. Apply affine pullback sections to P to U and this coefficient module. Compose with the unit-normalized composition isomorphism used to define the etale tensor-section restriction. Tensoring the ring identification with M produces an additive equivalence E to Gamma(P,P*F), whose value on m tensor tprod(b) is the product of the projection pullbacks of b_i times the normalized restriction of m.

Let q be evaluation at the unique outer Cech index followed by ULift.down. The normalization gives q(f(ULift.up t))=E(t) on pure generators. TensorProduct.induction_on reduces equality to pure tensors; PiTensorProduct.induction_on on the second factor reduces further to scalar multiples of indexed pure tensors. Additivity handles sums and the tensor balancing relation moves the scalar to the coefficient, so normalization applies to every remaining generator.
If f(x)=0, the preceding equality and additivity give E(x.down)=0=E(0). Injectivity of E gives x.down=0 and injectivity of ULift.down gives x=0.

theorem singletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom_kernel
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (hU : IsAffine U.left) (hW : IsAffine W.left)
    (n : ℕ)
    (f : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ⟶
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n)
    (hf : IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom X F U W g n f) :
    ∀ x, (AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom f) x = 0 → x = 0
